entry.id: urn:research-bot:ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准:finding:eu-ai-act-compliance-operationalization-is-a-dominant-research-focus-with-multiple-2025-2026-preprints-addressing-compli
entry.title: EU AI Act compliance operationalization is a dominant research focus, with multiple 2025-2026 preprints addressing compl
entry.summary: Three papers (2025-2026) specifically target EU AI Act implementation: compliance checkers assessment [28], machine-readable compliance evidence via OSCAL [27], and regulatory sandbox operationalization challenges [29].

entry.id: urn:research-bot:ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准:finding:isoiec-42001-ai-management-system-standard-is-being-integrated-with-regulatory-exposure-frameworks-and-compliance-toolin
entry.title: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system standard) is being integrated with regulatory exposure frameworks and compliance too
entry.summary: Paper [24] proposes a quantitative ROI framework integrating ISO 42001 and regulatory exposure; paper [27] lists ISO/IEC 42001 alongside EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF as governance frameworks requiring machine-readable evidence.

entry.id: urn:research-bot:ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准:finding:nist-ai-rmf-and-oscal-open-security-controls-assessment-language-are-proposed-as-technical-infrastructure-for-machine-re
entry.title: NIST AI RMF and OSCAL (Open Security Controls Assessment Language) are proposed as technical infrastructure for machine-
entry.summary: Paper [27] proposes OSCAL — a NIST standard used for FedRAMP — as interchange format for AI governance, defining 16 property extensions and a three-layer Compliance-as-Code architecture covering policy, evidence, enforcement.

entry.id: urn:research-bot:ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准:finding:eu-ai-act-regulatory-sandboxes-face-a-triple-challenge-of-capacity-coordination-and-attractiveness-to-providers
entry.title: EU AI Act regulatory sandboxes face a 'triple challenge' of capacity, coordination, and attractiveness to providers.
entry.summary: Paper [29] investigates the AI Act requirement for Member States to establish national AI regulatory sandboxes, identifying capacity constraints, coordination gaps, and low provider attractiveness as key operational hurdles.

entry.id: urn:research-bot:ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准:finding:risk-adjusted-roi-frameworks-are-emerging-to-quantify-ai-investments-under-regulatory-uncertainty-integrating-iso-42001
entry.title: Risk-adjusted ROI frameworks are emerging to quantify AI investments under regulatory uncertainty, integrating ISO 42001
entry.summary: Paper [24] presents a financial framework for quantifying AI project returns that explicitly integrates organizational risk profile changes from algorithmic malfunction, adversarial attacks, and regulatory liability, using ISO 42001 as a governance anchor.

entry.id: urn:research-bot:ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准:finding:候选证据中提供的-4-篇论文均为-2025-2026-年-arxiv-预印本提出新的运行层面-ai-治理框架oada五层框架governance-control-stack而非奠定当前国际框架的经典基石性原则宣言或早期法令
entry.title: 候选证据中提供的 4 篇论文均为 2025-2026 年 arXiv 预印本，提出新的运行层面 AI 治理框架（OADA、五层框架、Governance Control Stack），而非奠定当前国际框架的经典/基石性原则、宣言或早期法令。
entry.summary: 4 篇论文发表时间均在 2025-09 至 2026-05 之间，均为 arXiv 预印本（cs.CY / cs.AI / cs.HC），内容聚焦于运行保障、合规落地、控制栈等工程化治理机制。

entry.id: urn:research-bot:ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准:finding:alsayed-2026-提出-operational-ai-deployment-assurance-oada-框架强调治理状态编排阈值敏感部署条件下的整改进展与升级机制填补静态指标上报事后审计到部署就绪直接治理的空白
entry.title: Alsayed (2026) 提出 Operational AI Deployment Assurance (OADA) 框架，强调治理状态编排、阈值敏感部署条件下的整改进展与升级机制，填补‘静态指标上报/事后审计’到‘部署就绪直接治理’的
entry.summary: 论文指出现有方法停留在观测层面，OADA 引入公平性分歧、子群体不稳定性、阈值敏感性、整改结果与运行不确定性的量化治理。

entry.id: urn:research-bot:ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准:finding:五层-ai-治理框架-2025-试图将高层监管原则标准认证机制整合为结构化层级解决法规到合规落地的转化鸿沟
entry.title: 五层 AI 治理框架 (2025) 试图将高层监管原则、标准、认证机制整合为结构化层级，解决‘法规到合规落地’的转化鸿沟。
entry.summary: 论文明确目的为连接高层监管原则与实践实施，指出现有框架缺乏清晰的合规机制映射。

entry.id: urn:research-bot:ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准:finding:ai-governance-control-stack-2026-针对高风险决策环境提出从策略指导转向运行稳定性机制的强化治理架构关注可审计性与长期问责
entry.title: AI Governance Control Stack (2026) 针对高风险决策环境，提出从策略指导转向运行稳定性机制的强化治理架构，关注可审计性与长期问责。
entry.summary: 论文指出现有治理多停留在政策指导层面，Control Stack 旨在提供随时间保持可靠、可审计、可问责的运行机制。

entry.id: urn:research-bot:ai-治理与监管政策法规与标准:finding:naito-shirado-2026-实验发现超-40-参与者将-ai-视为个人行为预测权威导致放弃确定性奖励揭示对-ai-预测权威的信任可能窄化人类决策未来空间
entry.title: Naito & Shirado (2026) 实验发现：超 40% 参与者将 AI 视为个人行为预测权威，导致放弃确定性奖励，揭示‘对 AI 预测权威的信任’可能窄化人类决策未来空间。
entry.summary: 1,305 人行为实验，Newcomb 悖论范式，感知预测权威使放弃确定奖励几率升高 3.39 倍 (95% CI 2.45-4.70)，收益下降 10.7-42.9%。
